What the scope can include

A condition survey decides what should be retained, repaired or replaced.

Trading comes firstOvernight, closed-day or zone-by-zone work protects customer access and sales.
01Store layout refreshImprove customer flow, product zoning and service positions within the existing unit.
02Display upgradesReplace or rework shelving, wall systems, counters and feature displays.
03Lighting improvementsRetune ambient, accent and product lighting for the refreshed merchandise plan.
04Brand-store updateCarry revised colours, finishes, graphics and touchpoints through the space.
05Floor and ceiling worksRenew high-wear surfaces without unnecessary replacement elsewhere.
06Back-of-house upgradesImprove storage, staff areas, cash points and operational support zones.

A process shaped for retail & showroom renovation

Survey, scope, BOQ and phasing are agreed before disruptive work starts.

01

Trading audit

Map customer routes, peak hours, stock moves and safe work zones.

02

Refresh plan

Resolve what stays, what changes and the visual priorities.

03

Sample and BOQ

Approve finishes, display details and itemized quantities.

04

Out-of-hours works

Use overnight, closed-day or zoned execution where practical.

05

Merchandise-ready handover

Test lighting, clean the zone and return it ready for display.
